newsitem.title: CANADA: Alberta faces frost risk Sept 22 through Sept 30.
newsitem.headline: Alberta faces frost risk Sept 22 through Sept 30.

text.p: Alberta entire grainbelt was forecast to see a moderate to high risk of frost Sunday morning and each morning through to Sept 30, Environment Canada said.

A high risk of frost was forecast for Alberta's foothills and Peace River Valley while a moderate risk was seen on the rest of the grainbelt Sunday morning while southern and northwestern Saskatchewan's grainbelts face a slight risk, Environment Canada said in its 10-day outlook.
A high risk of frost was forecast for the west and south of Alberta Monday and Tuesday mornings.
A moderate risk was seen on the rest of Alberta and across south Saskatchewan and Manitoba Monday and Tuesday mornings.
A high risk of frost was expected across Alberta, Saskatchewan and western Manitoba Wednesday and Thursday mornings with a moderate risk in the rest of Manitoba.
A moderate risk of frost was forecast across Alberta and western Saskatchewan Sept 27 to 30.
A moderate risk of frost was forecast for eastern Saskatchewan and western Manitoba Sept 28 to Sept 30.
A moderate risk of frost was forecast for the rest of Manitoba Sept 29 and Sept 30.
